tasks.title: Before Todoist: scope GitHub's import to one repo, or hide it? And a test token.
tasks.description:
🟡 #40 · Todoist: scope the GitHub import or hide it first? And a test token

Coral's rec: Scope it to one repo the user picks. Todoist needs the same "pick one list" step, so the two share a screen, and hiding would take a feature away from people who have 1.1. The token: Todoist → Settings → Integrations → Developer. It stays on this machine, outside the repo. Two smaller questions remain in the write-up (answering from a card; whether this replaces R4.1 and R4.3): https://github.com/Design-in-Product/one-job/blob/main/docs/AGENT-DECK-VIA-INTEGRATIONS-2026-10.md
